facts.fact: Devan's chest/back at ch21: nine fresh silk stitches on the right ribs beside the old ford seam, and the ladder-hook cut across the back, dressed; Neela feels the right-rib ache while kissing past the stitches.

At dawn Devan tells Neela the exact cost of reading the writ: three hundred spears under captains who do not know him, about seventy-odd defenders, fourteen hundred Thurai beyond the cut; he says the reading may cost the spears and the pass. The cut gift seal is in the bundle (Devan kept it in his sleeve, F071).
